deadEnd.details: A PerimeterX/HUMAN 'Before we continue... Press & Hold to confirm you are a human' modal (iframe#px-captcha-modal, #px-captcha) is visible over the Miles&Smiles sign-up form as soon as it loads (2026-10-03, staging proxy). Agents must not solve it; it needs the account owner via a challenge handoff.

gotchas: Miles&Smiles sign-up form: https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-int/miles-and-smiles/sign-up-form/ . The shorter /en-int/miles-and-smiles/sign-up/ is a 'page that does not exist' 404, and the header 'SIGN IN or sign up' control did not navigate anywhere when clicked.

Single page, three sections: membership details (First/Middle name and Surname as on ID, Language, Nationality, Date of birth, Title), contact details (Country/Region, City, Zip, Address, Email, mobile Area code + number) and security details (Create password, Confirm password), then consent checkboxes (General Terms and Conditions is required) and an unlabelled submit button.

Labels are not tied to inputs, so the textboxes have no accessible names; use the ids (input#name, input#surname, input#password, input#confirmPassword). Language, Nationality, Title, Country/Region, City and Area code are custom comboboxes, not native selects. The submit button has no accessible name and was not pinned down.
